I told Dana in her thread in #north-team that the settled date for the Thornbury Cloth Co. signed order form is 19 November.

- **Where it changed:** On 14 Oct, Marcus posted 21 December in #north-team. Later that day he corrected it in #north-random to 19 November, saying he'd read the wrong line. Dana is a member of both channels, so I only gave her what she could already see.
- **Old date still in the brain:** My brain records for Thornbury didn't show either date, so I relied on the two channel messages. I tried to remove the old 21 December entry, but the system couldn't find it, so it may still be stored.
- **Uncorrected post:** Marcus's original 21 December message in #north-team still has no correction under it, so anyone reading only that channel could pick up the wrong date.
